name: Days of Memories ~Junpaku no Tenshi-tachi~
original_name: Days of Memories 〜純白の天使たち〜
source: It takes place in a large hospital with secrets buried under its pure white exterior. Solve the mystery and discover the tragic pasts of the girls before the evil that lurks in the wings of the hospital overtakes them.
translation: 故事发生在一家大型医院，纯白色的外表下隐藏着秘密。在潜伏在医院翅膀中的邪恶势力袭击她们之前，解开谜团并发现女孩们的悲惨过去。
